All three review findings are fixed on this head; each was verified against the running code before the change.

**[P1] Persist the product-default choice for profile users** — root cause was `resetValue` in `ui/src/app/server-prefs-state.ts`: with a profile active it must be *what deleting the profile key falls back to* (the gateway value), not the product default. With that corrected, `setTheme`/`setThemeMode`'s `value === resetValue` classification only treats a click on the actual fallback value as a reset, so an explicit product-default choice becomes a `users.prefs.set` write. `resetServerUiPref` now also lands local settings on that fallback for any profile-bound appearance reset, not just `provenance === "profile"`. Regression: `server-prefs.profile.test.ts` "targets reset at the gateway value so an explicit product-default choice persists" (asserts `resetValue === "dash"`, the profile write of `"claw"`, and the reset landing on `"dash"`).

**[P1] Reapply a profile when the active identity changes** — the per-scope last-seen state short-circuited both the whole-object shortcut and the per-key delta in `applyServerUiPrefs`. A switch between two known scopes now forces a full reconcile (boot keeps the shortcut so legacy device-local values are untouched), and appearance keys the returning identity never recorded are cleared back to defaults so B's accent cannot linger on A. Pending/retained-local shadowing is preserved. Regression: "reapplies the returning profile's appearance after an identity switch" covers A→B→A for theme and the lingering-accent clear.

**[P2] Do not project gateway accent while GitHub identity is pending** — `talk.config` is now in `PROFILE_DEPENDENT_CORE_METHODS`, so the established dispatch gate *awaits the pending GitHub identity sync* before the handler runs (profile-less/token clients have no sync handle and pass through untouched; a failed sync returns the existing retryable profile-unavailable error). Pinned in `registry.test.ts`.

Exact-head CI is green on this head; the earlier live multi-identity proof (screenshots/video above) covers the unchanged happy paths.

The custom-theme finding is fixed on head d364920d61e, aligned with the existing documented contract that imported palettes live only in the browser that imported them:

- `UI_APPEARANCE_THEME_VALUES` (the profile wire contract) no longer includes `custom`, so readers treat any stored `custom` as unset and fall back to the gateway value — the store self-heals.
- A profile-bound `custom` selection is retained browser-local instead of syncing (`pushServerUiPrefs` blocks it; the offline-queued path is diverted in the drain), while other appearance keys in the same batch still sync. The existing "Stored in this browser only" hint then describes the situation truthfully.
- The Control UI keeps honoring config-synced `custom` (unchanged palette-gated `canApply` path); the UI theme set is now `[...wire contract, "custom"]` with the difference named in a comment.
- The exhaustive theme test now encodes the exception (`custom: false`) and a new regression covers the mixed batch (accent syncs, custom stays local).

`docs/concepts/user-model.md` documents the exception.
